notes: Deterministic audit tests run with evals/run_audit_tests.py. Behavioral evals (write/scout) run with skill-creator; private fixtures from the original chat export live in evals/private/ and are gitignored.

evals.prompt: Here's the transcript of my Monday management sync (attached). Anything in there worth a LinkedIn post? Draft one if so.
evals.expected_output: A story file with a receipt pointing at the upload, one draft that opens on the event, passes stanley-audit, and a single question asking the user for their claim; no invented numbers.

evals.prompt: Find me 3 posts on LinkedIn and X to comment on today and draft the comments. Don't show me anything you've shown me before.
evals.expected_output: 2–3 picks per platform with link, author, one-line why, and a 1–3 sentence comment each; none by the user; none in surfaced.jsonl; comments pass --platform comment audit.

evals.prompt: This sounds like AI. Rewrite it so it sounds like me: <draft>
evals.expected_output: A rewrite that removes the flagged patterns, keeps every specific, uses the voice.md exemplars' rhythm, stores the diff, and names the pattern that was fixed in one line.
